capabilities.title: Rebuild stock balance projections

capabilities.title: Record counted quantities
capabilities.intent: Enter physical count results into an open cycle count; posting happens separately once every line has been counted and reviewed

capabilities.title: Release reservation
capabilities.intent: Release an open stock reservation back to available-to-promise when the claiming order is cancelled or re-planned

capabilities.title: Reserve stock
capabilities.intent: Place an open claim against available stock for a sales order, work order, or other commitment; reservations never move the ledger but reduce what is promiseable

reason.description: what is claiming this stock, e.g. 'SO-1042'

capabilities.title: Restore prior item details
capabilities.intent: Re-apply the prior snapshot captured by an item update, undoing that edit; restoring is itself a normal update and can be undone the same way

capabilities.title: Restore imported catalog items
capabilities.intent: Restore catalog items after reversing an import undo while keeping item identity and stock history intact

capabilities.title: Reverse stock transfer
capabilities.intent: Undo a confirmed transfer by moving the confirmed quantities back in one mirroring transfer, marking the original reversed; each transfer may be reversed once

capabilities.title: Reverse inventory valuation summary
capabilities.intent: Reverse a previously posted inventory valuation summary with the exact mirrored entry, restoring the GL to its pre-posting state; each summary may be reversed at most once

capabilities.title: Stock levels report
capabilities.intent: Show every tracked item with on-hand quantity, moving-average value, open reservations, and available-to-promise so purchasing and sales see the same truth

capabilities.title: Undo catalog import
capabilities.intent: Archive only the items created by a recent spreadsheet import, preserving their references and any stock history

capabilities.title: Update item details
capabilities.intent: Edit an item's name, unit label, selling price, image, tags, or barcode; the declared inverse restores the exact prior values

capabilities.title: BOM report
capabilities.intent: Show a product's bill of materials with exploded, scrap-adjusted component requirements and whether enough stock exists to build a given quantity

capabilities.title: BOM tree
capabilities.intent: Show an assembly's bill of materials as a nested multi-level tree with cumulatively scaled component quantities per level

capabilities.title: Cancel work order
capabilities.intent: Cancel a draft or released work order that will not be produced; completed orders are immutable and reverse via run reversal instead

capabilities.title: Check production feasibility
capabilities.intent: Answer can-we-produce-N with the arithmetic: BOM-explosed component needs versus stock, per-component shortfalls, the producible ceiling, and the estimated lead time

capabilities.title: Complete work order
capabilities.intent: Post a released work order's build: consume BOM components with scrap allowances and add finished units at rolled-up cost, closing the order

lotCode.description: assign the finished output to this production lot

capabilities.title: Production cost preview
capabilities.intent: Preview what producing a quantity would consume and cost at current moving-average unit prices, including scrap allowances and expected yield loss, before posting anything

capabilities.title: Create work order
capabilities.intent: Plan a production run for an assembled product as a draft work order with a planned quantity and expected yield; release it later to build

capabilities.title: Define bill of materials
capabilities.intent: Set or replace the component list for an assembled product so production can consume parts and build stock; cycles are rejected

capabilities.title: Delete bill of materials
capabilities.intent: Remove an assembly's bill of materials entirely when the product is no longer built; production and work orders refuse assemblies without a BOM

capabilities.title: Lot traceability
capabilities.intent: Trace a finished-goods lot upstream through every component lot that fed it, for recall investigations and supplier accountability

capabilities.title: Produce from BOM
capabilities.intent: Build a quantity of an assembled product by consuming its components at moving-average cost and adding finished units at rolled-up cost, refusing when parts are short

lotCode.description: assign the finished output to a production lot

capabilities.title: Production run history
capabilities.intent: List past production runs (instant or work-order builds) with what was produced, which components were consumed, and the rolled-up cost

capabilities.title: Release work order
capabilities.intent: Approve a draft work order for the shop floor after confirming every exploded BOM component (including scrap allowances) is in stock

capabilities.title: Reverse production run
capabilities.intent: Undo a completed production run or work-order build by mirroring every movement it posted: components return to stock at their recorded costs and finished units leave

capabilities.title: Work order list
capabilities.intent: Show planned production work orders with status, planned versus built quantities, and expected good output at yield

capabilities.title: Campaign analytics
capabilities.intent: Report provider-confirmed campaign delivery straight from the outbox - no pixels, no guesses

capabilities.title: Create campaign
capabilities.intent: Draft a campaign against a saved segment with subject and body; nothing is sent until sendCampaign runs

capabilities.title: Create segment
capabilities.intent: Save a deterministic customer filter - everyone whose lifetime spend is at least the threshold - so campaigns target the same people every time

capabilities.title: Send campaign
capabilities.intent: Deliver a campaign to every segment member who has not opted out, recording one append-only send-log row each - opted-out customers are never contacted

capabilities.title: Add channel member
capabilities.intent: Add a colleague to an internal channel so they can read its history and join the discussion

capabilities.title: Mark conversation read
capabilities.intent: Record how far a colleague has read an internal conversation so unread counts stay accurate across devices

capabilities.title: Archive or restore conversation
capabilities.intent: Move an internal channel out of the everyday list when it is finished, or bring it back, keeping its full history readable

capabilities.title: Create internal conversation
capabilities.intent: Open a new internal team channel or direct message in this organization with the actor as its first member, so colleagues can be added and messaged

capabilities.title: Delete conversation
capabilities.intent: Remove a channel the actor created from the organization's conversation list because it was created by mistake or is no longer wanted, keeping the audit trail intact

capabilities.title: Delete message
capabilities.intent: Withdraw one of your own messages from an internal conversation, replacing it with a deletion marker while keeping the audit trail intact

capabilities.title: Remove pending message attachment
capabilities.intent: Discard an uploaded file that has not yet been sent as part of a message

capabilities.title: Edit message
capabilities.intent: Correct the wording of one of your own messages in an internal conversation, marking it as edited while keeping the correction on the record

capabilities.title: Leave conversation
capabilities.intent: Remove the actor's own membership from an internal channel or direct message so it stops appearing in their list, without deleting anything for others

capabilities.title: List conversations
capabilities.intent: List internal channels and DMs with their latest activity, so you can find where to post or read

capabilities.title: List mentionable people
capabilities.intent: List the organization's members and the AI workmate so a message can @mention the right person or pull the agent into a conversation

capabilities.title: Read conversation messages
capabilities.intent: Read recent messages from an internal conversation to catch up on context

capabilities.title: Restore conversation presence
capabilities.intent: Restore a member's earlier short-lived presence after reversing a presence update

capabilities.title: Restore deleted message
capabilities.intent: Restore your own message after a matching successful deletion, only while that exact deletion timestamp is still current

capabilities.title: Restore message edit
capabilities.intent: Restore the prior wording of your own internal message after a matching successful edit, only while the edited wording is still current

capabilities.title: Restore message pin
capabilities.intent: Restore a message's earlier pinned state after reversing a pin change

capabilities.title: Restore message reaction
capabilities.intent: Restore a colleague's earlier reaction state after reversing a reaction change

capabilities.title: Restore read position
capabilities.intent: Restore a conversation read position when reversing an earlier read receipt update

capabilities.title: Send internal message
capabilities.intent: Post a message into an internal team conversation (channel or DM), optionally @mentioning colleagues or the agent so they are notified. Use to keep colleagues informed or answer them in threads

capabilities.title: Pin conversation message
capabilities.intent: Pin an important conversation message for its members or remove an existing pin

capabilities.title: React to message
capabilities.intent: Add or remove a supported emoji reaction on a message in a conversation the colleague belongs to

capabilities.title: Update conversation
capabilities.intent: Rename an internal channel or turn its AI workmate participation on or off, keeping shared spaces named and governed as the team changes

capabilities.title: Update conversation presence
capabilities.intent: Update a member's short-lived online and typing status in an internal conversation

capabilities.title: Upload message attachment
capabilities.intent: Store a file privately for a message in a conversation the colleague belongs to

capabilities.title: Close register session
capabilities.intent: Count the cash drawer and close the session; reports any variance between counted and expected cash

capabilities.title: Complete POS sale
capabilities.intent: Ring up a paid sale on the register: creates the invoice and records the payment instantly. Cash sales count toward the drawer

quantity.description: thousandths of a unit; 1000 = one unit

sku.description: stocked item to decrement; omit for services

capabilities.title: Open register session
capabilities.intent: Open a point-of-sale cash drawer session with an opening float before taking sales

capabilities.title: Return POS sale
capabilities.intent: Take goods back at the register: refund the customer through a balanced reversing entry, credit the sale invoice, and put the stock back on the shelf - the original sale is never edited

capabilities.title: Shift summary
capabilities.intent: Summarize a register session - sales count, takings, expected versus counted cash, and variance - so closing a shift is a check, not a guess

capabilities.title: Archive project
capabilities.intent: Retire a finished or abandoned project; its history stays queryable

capabilities.title: Assign task
capabilities.intent: Put a named person on a task so ownership is never ambiguous

capabilities.title: Create project
capabilities.intent: Start a project with a name and an optional due date so work has a home and a deadline

capabilities.title: Create project task
capabilities.intent: Add a task (or a subtask under a parent) to a project with an assignee, due date, and priority, positioned in its kanban column

capabilities.title: Delete task
capabilities.intent: Remove a task only when its complete saved snapshot is unchanged and it has no children

capabilities.title: Project board
capabilities.intent: Render a project's kanban board - every task with its column, position, assignee, due date, and priority

capabilities.title: Move task
capabilities.intent: Drag a task across the board - todo, doing, done - with an explicit column position

capabilities.title: Restore project
capabilities.intent: Restore a project that was archived by its matching project action

capabilities.title: Restore task
capabilities.intent: Restore the exact task row removed by its matching guarded delete action

capabilities.title: Restore task assignment
capabilities.intent: Restore task ownership only while the current assignee still matches the expected value

capabilities.title: Restore task placement
capabilities.intent: Restore a task column and position only while it still has the expected placement

capabilities.title: AP aging report
capabilities.intent: Show outstanding vendor bills bucketed by age so you know what you owe and when

capabilities.title: Credit a vendor bill
capabilities.intent: Record a supplier credit against an open bill - an approved reversing entry that reduces what is owed without editing the bill

capabilities.title: Cancel payment run draft
capabilities.intent: Cancel a supplier payment run that has not been approved or sent as a bank instruction

capabilities.title: Close purchase order
capabilities.intent: Close an order that will not be fully received; if quantities are short the order is marked backordered so the shortfall stays on the vendor's record

capabilities.title: Record vendor bill
capabilities.intent: Record an invoice received from a supplier; posts the expense and the amount owed to Accounts Payable

expenseAccountCode.description: chart-of-accounts code the cost lands on, e.g. 5000 for COGS

capabilities.title: Create supplier payment run
capabilities.intent: Select outstanding supplier bills into one same-currency payment run for review, approval, and a consolidated bank instruction

capabilities.title: Create purchase order
capabilities.intent: Order goods from a vendor with line items and expected prices; receiving and billing are matched against this order later

sku.description: links the line to a stocked item for receipts

capabilities.title: Create purchase request
capabilities.intent: Raise an internal purchase request for review and approval before anything is ordered; the first step of the procure-to-pay workflow

capabilities.title: Send RFQ to vendors
capabilities.intent: Request competitive quotes from one or more vendors for an approved purchase request, creating one tracked RFQ per vendor

capabilities.title: Create vendor
capabilities.intent: Register a supplier so bills can be recorded against them

capabilities.title: Approve or reject purchase request
capabilities.intent: Record a reviewer's approve or reject decision on a pending purchase request; only approved requests may go out as RFQs

capabilities.title: Approve payment instructions
capabilities.intent: Approve a reviewed supplier payment run, post its bill settlements once, and prepare one consolidated bank instruction for later statement confirmation

capabilities.title: List supplier payment runs
capabilities.intent: List draft, instructed, confirmed, and reversed supplier payment runs with their bill-level remittance details and reconciliation state

capabilities.title: List purchase requests and RFQs
capabilities.intent: List recent internal purchase requests with their approval state and every RFQ bid on them, so you can review, chase quotes, or award a winner

capabilities.title: List goods receipts for a purchase order
capabilities.intent: Show each receipt an order produced - per line what was accepted, rejected, returned, and what remains outstanding - so receiving and three-way matching can be checked by hand

capabilities.title: Pay vendor bill
capabilities.intent: Pay money to a supplier against an outstanding bill and post it to the ledger. Amounts above the policy threshold require approval

capabilities.title: Supplier price history
capabilities.intent: Show what each vendor has actually charged per item across purchase orders over time, so a 'special price' can be checked against the record

capabilities.title: Receive goods against purchase order
capabilities.intent: Record that ordered goods physically arrived; adds received quantities to stock for linked items and updates the order status. Receipts feed three-way matching on bills

quantity.description: accepted thousandths - the only quantity that stocks and bills

rejected.description: arrived but refused; recorded, never stocked

capabilities.title: Record a vendor quote
capabilities.intent: Log a vendor's quote (amount, lead time, notes) against an open RFQ so bids can be compared and a winner selected

capabilities.title: Restore payment run draft
capabilities.intent: Restore a cancelled supplier payment run draft that has never been instructed to a bank

capabilities.title: Return goods to vendor
capabilities.intent: Send received goods back to the vendor: writes negative stock legs against the purchase order so receipts, fill rates, and stock stay truthful

capabilities.title: Reverse supplier payment run
capabilities.intent: Reverse an instructed but not bank-confirmed supplier payment run, restore every bill balance, and retain the original instruction and reversal evidence

capabilities.title: Reverse vendor payment
capabilities.intent: Undo a recorded vendor payment: mirror its journal entry in the original currency, release the amount from the bill balance, and refuse if the payment was already reversed. The bill can then receive a corrected payment

capabilities.title: Select winning quote and raise PO
capabilities.intent: Award an approved request to a vendor's quoted price: marks that RFQ won, its siblings lost, and raises the purchase order so receiving and billing can proceed

capabilities.title: Supplier performance
capabilities.intent: Summarize each vendor's delivery record - average lead time from order to receipt, fill rate, backorders, and late arrivals against promised dates

capabilities.title: Supplier statement
capabilities.intent: Render a vendor's account as a dated, running-balance statement of bills, payments, and supplier credits - what you reconcile their month-end statement against

capabilities.title: Create routine
capabilities.intent: Create a recurring agent routine from a natural-language schedule so the workmate repeats this task automatically

capabilities.title: Delete routine
capabilities.intent: Delete a recurring routine by id and return its fields so the deletion can be reversed by recreating it

capabilities.title: List routines
capabilities.intent: List the org's recurring agent routines with their schedules, next run times, and last run status

capabilities.title: Run routine now
capabilities.intent: Trigger one immediate run of an existing routine through the durable job queue instead of waiting for its schedule

capabilities.title: Update routine
capabilities.intent: Rename a routine, edit its prompt, change its schedule, or enable and disable it; schedule changes recompute the next run

capabilities.title: Cancel sales order
capabilities.intent: Withdraw a draft or confirmed order before shipment, releasing every stock reservation it still holds so the quantity returns to available-to-promise

capabilities.title: Confirm sales order
capabilities.intent: Commit a draft sales order: check the customer's credit headroom, reserve stock for every stock-backed line, and flag backorders when supply falls short

capabilities.title: Create sales order
capabilities.intent: Draft a sales order for a customer with priced lines so that confirming it later can reserve stock and ship without retyping anything

capabilities.title: Deliver sales order
capabilities.intent: Ship all or part of a confirmed order: consume its reservations, write the outgoing stock legs, and raise an invoice for exactly what was delivered

capabilities.title: List sales orders
capabilities.intent: Show the organization's sales orders with status, backorder flags, and totals so the team can see what is committed, short, and ready to ship

capabilities.title: Configure workspace model provider
capabilities.intent: Set the workspace model provider, endpoint, model roles, and encrypted API credential for governed agent runs

capabilities.title: Restore workspace model provider
capabilities.intent: Restore a previously saved workspace model provider configuration after a governed configuration change

capabilities.title: List business signals
capabilities.intent: Collect every module's needs-attention signals - stockout risk, dead stock, overdue receivables, stalled deals - sorted red first, each with evidence and a suggested governed action

capabilities.title: Find a skill
capabilities.intent: Search advisory playbooks for multi-step operations like buying, selling, collecting overdue invoices, closing the books, running payroll, or handling support, and get back one-line summaries

task.description: What the user wants done, in a few words, e.g. 'buy stock from a new vendor'

capabilities.title: Load a skill
capabilities.intent: Expand one skill into its concise step-by-step playbook and the capabilities that execute it

capabilities.title: Create canned response
capabilities.intent: Save a reusable reply under a short shortcut so agents answer consistently in one step

capabilities.title: Create KB article
capabilities.intent: Author a knowledge-base article so recurring questions get answered once, publicly

capabilities.title: File support ticket
capabilities.intent: Record a ticket for something that cannot be handled honestly right now - a capability gap, a bug, or an explicit request - so a human picks it up on the record

capabilities.title: Escalate support conversation
capabilities.intent: Hand a customer care thread to a human owner with the reason spelled out when the answer needs authority the assistant does not have

capabilities.title: List support conversations
capabilities.intent: List the organization's customer care threads with their latest activity, optionally filtered by status

capabilities.title: Look up this customer's order status
capabilities.intent: For the current support thread's own customer only: recent invoices with payment status and outstanding amounts, to answer where-things-stand questions from real records

capabilities.title: Log support message
capabilities.intent: Append an entry to a customer care thread: what the customer wrote, what staff replied, or an AI-drafted reply released by a human

capabilities.title: Read support conversation
capabilities.intent: Load a customer care thread's messages in order, including who sent each entry, before replying or handing off

capabilities.title: Reopen support conversation
capabilities.intent: Reopen a resolved or escalated customer care thread because the customer came back or the handoff was premature

capabilities.title: Resolve support conversation
capabilities.intent: Close a customer care thread once the inquiry is answered, keeping the full exchange on record

capabilities.title: Search knowledge base
capabilities.intent: Search the organization's remembered policies and business profile to ground customer answers in real facts instead of inventing them

capabilities.title: Start support conversation
capabilities.intent: Open a customer care thread bound to one existing customer so inquiries about them are handled on the record

capabilities.title: Suggest ticket category
capabilities.intent: Draft a category for a ticket from its text using fixed rules - a suggestion, never a decision

capabilities.title: Update ticket
capabilities.intent: Set a ticket's priority, category, assignee, and SLA due date so aging and breaches are measurable instead of vibes
